claims.statement: SignWell provides legally binding eSignatures compliant with SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA standards.
SignWell offers REST API for embedding signing workflows into third-party products.
Customers report SignWell eliminates printing/scanning steps for contract execution.
Professional users describe SignWell as more elegant and easier to use than DocuSign.
API documentation quality enables seamless integration into customer workflows.
SignWell maintains detailed audit trails for all signed documents.

scoreRationale.onboarding: A simple send-and-sign path plus vendor customer accounts describing easy adoption support 8.2, with no Digital Macaroni hands-on test.
scoreRationale.product: Legally binding signatures, templates, audit trails, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA support, and an API provide strong core depth, supporting 8.0.
scoreRationale.support: The accessible packet did not provide enough independent support evidence, so uncertainty limits the score to 7.0.
scoreRationale.billing: Plan detail was incomplete in the evidence packet, while the simple core product still supports a cautious 7.2 pending a live quote.
scoreRationale.overall: SignWell appears to cover the core signing job well, but thin independent evidence limits the overall score to 7.6.
